name: LogicInference
description: Machine learning models such as Transformers or LSTMs struggle with tasks that are compositional in nature such as those involving reasoning/inference. Although many datasets exist to evaluate compositional generalization, when it comes to evaluating inference abilities, options are more limited. This paper presents LogicInference, a new dataset to evaluate the ability of models to perform logical inference.
reputation: A relatively small research benchmark with limited but relevant use for probing logical inference in language models.
notes: Likely a small, specialized dataset; not a widely standardized benchmark and may be sensitive to prompt/setup differences.
